capabilities: Render an infobox card from an infobox: block in YAML frontmatter
Edit infobox fields, tags, and images in a visual editor that writes back to frontmatter
Save infoboxes as reusable template notes and insert them into other notes
Customize per-note colors and vault-wide colors via Style Settings
Render field values as bulleted lists from arrays, bullets, pipes, or commas
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation via community plugin browser or manual file copy is documented; no usage warnings beyond YAML quoting pitfalls.
problem: Obsidian only shows frontmatter properties as a plain key-value list, so structured summary data like titles, images, and key-value fields cannot be displayed as a compact card.

relations.evidence: For vault-wide colors, install the optional Style Settings plugin and open its Omni Infobox section
This works alongside Obsidian's core Templates plugin; it does not require it

summary: Renders Wikipedia-style infobox cards from a note's YAML frontmatter, with a visual editor and a pinned top-right panel in reading and editing views.
